node.statement: Define D_1=id_{S_{P_1,Q}}. If D_{j-1}:S_{P_[1,j-1],Q}->direct-sum_{r=1}^{j-1}S_{P_r,Q} is a bounded complex-linear bijection, define D_j=(D_{j-1} direct-sum id_{S_{P_j,Q}}) composed with A_j^(-1). It is a bounded complex-linear bijection, with bounded inverse A_j composed with (D_{j-1}^(-1) direct-sum id). Finite induction therefore constructs D_p:S_{P_[1,p],Q}->direct-sum_{r=1}^p S_{P_r,Q}; node 1.1 gives P_[1,p]=v(I_B)=P, yielding the asserted bijection.
